name: cicy-keystore
title: Cicy Keystore
description: List keys and notes in the cicy-code keystore and run commands with secrets injected as env vars. Values are set only in the UI and are never printed.
author: cicy-ai

zh-CN.title: Cicy 密钥库
zh-CN.description: 列出 cicy-code 密钥库中的 key 和说明，并把密钥作为环境变量注入命令运行。值只能在界面里设置，任何时候都不会打印出来。

tools.name: cicy-keystore list
tools.description: List every key, whether it is set, and its note (never values)

tools.name: cicy-keystore show
tools.description: Show one key's note and status

tools.name: cicy-keystore exec
tools.description: Run a command with keys injected as env vars; values are masked as *** in its output
